_comment: Mutation testing for arp-domain (ADR-0081). On-demand / differential gate, NOT a per-push check: run it when you want to know whether the domain's tests are load-bearing, or on the files a PR changed (--mutate). packages/domain is the calibration target because ADR-024 keeps it pure — no I/O, no environment, so every mutant is cheap to run.
_plugins_comment: Explicit, not the default `@stryker-mutator/*` glob: under pnpm's isolated node_modules the glob finds no sibling plugins next to the hoisted core, and the runner fails with 'Cannot find TestRunner plugin "vitest"'.
